newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot plans to lease DC-10 freighter.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot plans to lease DC-10 freighter.

text.p: Aeroflot-Russian International Airlines plans to lease a DC-10 freighter to expand its international cargo operations, a senior company official said on Monday.
Yevgeny Blinov, deputy chief of Aeroflot-cargo, told Reuters that the freighter would be leased later this year.
"We have a big interest in leasing the DC-10 because it will help us to carry cargo more efficiently," he said.
Aeroflot has been operating one DC-10-30F jet since October 1995.
Last week Valery Okulov, Aeroflot chief executive, said that the company carried 90,100 tonnes of cargo in 1995, up from 70,500 tonnes in the previous year.
"We are operating the DC-10 jet on the Frankfurt-Seoul and Frankfurt-Tokyo scheduled cargo routes and this aircraft is showing excellent results," Okulov said.

Currently, Aeroflot operates 13 freighters including 12 Russian-made Ilyushin Il-76s and one DC-10 jet. In September the company will begin operating a new Ilyushin Il-96T, powered by U.S. engines and avionics.
